Chicken, broilers or fryers, breast, meat only, cooked, roasted

scale_cues: Used the white dinner plate as the scale reference: it is roughly 27 cm across, so each chicken slice is about 6-8 cm long and each cucumber cube about 2 cm. Cutlery and hands are not visible. Grams come from typical piece thickness and volume estimated against the plate area.
assumptions: Meat slices are assumed to be chicken breast; they could be pork or turkey, which would change the FDC entry but not the mass much.
The battered pieces are assumed to be fried chicken thigh with skin and breading.
Green cubes are assumed to be cucumber; they could be chayote or zucchini.
Small brown specks near the cucumber (possibly seasoning or bacon bits) are under 5 g in total and are not listed separately.
No sauces, dressings, oil, or drinks are visible. Any cooking oil absorbed into the fried coating is included in the fried chicken estimate.
Masses refer to edible cooked weight on the plate, not raw weight.
